reason:
The prototype's bank cards keep the captured table head cells as visually-hidden prefixes ("Telefon: ", "Kontakt oss: ") before every phone / contact link; the diff reads them as body text. EDS authors the links without the hidden prefix (the tel:/mailto:/contact links carry the meaning — a hidden label cannot be authored in David's Model). Those prefixes then shadow the real "Telefon" address-card heading and the "Kontakt oss" links, which ARE in the EDS document (content/nb/bank/privat/kundeservice/kontakt.html:

Telefon

, the helgeland / ostlandet #contact-tab1 anchors).
